Radiculopathy refers to disease of the nerve roots. The reference diagnosis includes 'polyradiculopathy' as a component, but 'Radiculopathy' alone is less specific and misses the underlying BPDCN.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: a component of the neurological manifestation
